about: Lunar atlas: notable landing sites beyond the south-pole catalog. Coordinates are planetocentric MOON_ME (DE421 mean Earth), degrees north / east, copied from the primary source named on each entry. See docs/DATA.md.

sites.source: NASA NSSDCA, Apollo Landing Site Coordinates (Lunar Module; Wagner et al. 2017, Icarus 283:92), https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/lunar/lunar_sites.html

sites.name: Chang'e 3
sites.note: Mare Imbrium; with the Yutu rover
sites.source: LROC, 2016 LROC Coordinates of Human Features (NASA/GSFC/ASU), https://www.lroc.asu.edu/data/support/downloads/2016_LROC_Coordinates_of_Human_Features.pdf

sites.name: Chang'e 4
sites.note: First far-side landing, Von Kármán crater; talks to Earth through the Queqiao relay satellite

sites.name: Chang'e 6
sites.note: First far-side sample return, Apollo basin; relay via Queqiao-2

sites.name: SLIM
sites.note: Pinpoint landing near Shioli crater (tipped on its nose)

sites.name: IM-1 Odysseus
sites.note: First commercial landing, near Malapert A; landed on a slope and tipped
sites.source: NASA, 'NASA's LRO Images Intuitive Machines' Odysseus Lander', https://www.nasa.gov/missions/lro/nasas-lro-images-intuitive-machines-odysseus-lander/

sites.name: Blue Ghost 1
sites.note: Mare Crisium near Mons Latreille; coordinates are LROC's landing-region centre (published before landing)
sites.source: LROC, 'Firefly Blue Ghost Landing Region' (NASA/GSFC/ASU), https://lroc.im-ldi.com/images/1400

sites.name: IM-3 target: Reiner Gamma
sites.note: Planned CLPS mission to the Reiner Gamma lunar swirl; coordinates are the IAU feature centre, not a landing point
sites.source: IAU/USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, Reiner Gamma (centre), https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/
